10:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
11:     osc.type = 'square';
12:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.08, audioCtx.currentTime);

15:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);

76:   // ----- Entity creation -----

79:     const pos = { x: 0, y: 0 };
80:     const vel = { x: 0, y: 0 };
